$meta.name: jmbt.dev baseline design tokens
$meta.source: src/styles/global.css at commit 8e84b73, verified against computed styles on https://jmbt.dev
$meta.method: Values marked declared are real CSS custom properties. Values marked derived were read from getComputedStyle in headless Chrome or tallied from literals in global.css, because the codebase declares no tokens for them.
$meta.warning: This codebase declares only 6 custom properties. Everything else is a hard-coded literal. Treat the derived sections as an inventory of what is in use, not as an existing token system.

bg.role: page background, also the ::selection text color

fg.role: primary text, link rest state, brand wordmark
fg.wcag: AA and AAA for all text sizes

dim.role: secondary text, nav rest, footer, project stack, link underline
dim.wcag: AA for all text sizes, AAA for large only

accent.role: single accent. Link hover, focus ring, prompt glyphs, cursor block, h2 marker, selection background
accent.wcag: AA and AAA for all text sizes
accent.note: Warm brass or antique gold. The only chromatic value in the entire palette.

border.role: hairline rules, footer top border, card edges
border.wcag: Decorative only. Fails 3:1 for non-text UI, acceptable for a pure separator.

asciiGradientMid.role: midpoint of the hero ASCII art radial gradient, between accent and dim

color._scheme: dark only. meta name=color-scheme is content=dark. There is no light theme and no prefers-color-scheme handling anywhere.

family.value: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
family.note: Single family. Monospace for body copy as well as headings, which is the core of the current identity.

files.note: Declared via unicode-range and never requested on any current page. It is dead weight in the repo but costs nothing at runtime.

typeScale.note: The scale is unusually flat. Only four distinct sizes exist and h2 is the same size as body copy, separated from it by weight and a '## ' marker rather than by size. This is the main typographic lever the revamp has available.

fluid.note: The ASCII hero is the only fluid type in the system. It scales to keep 48 columns on one line.

spacing._status: derived. No spacing custom properties exist. These are the literal rem values tallied from global.css, ordered by frequency of use.
spacing.observation: Broadly a 4px grid with 0.5rem, 1.5rem and 2rem carrying most of the weight. 0.875rem and 1.75rem are the two off-grid outliers.

layout.measure: Roughly 72 monospace characters at 16px, a deliberate single-column reading column shared by header, main and footer.

breakpoints.effect: root font-size drops to 14px, main padding-top to 2.5rem
definition list collapses from two columns to one
header stacks vertically, nav gap tightens

layout.note: All three breakpoints are max-width. The system is desktop-first.

radius.note: No border-radius anywhere in global.css. Every edge is square. This is a defining trait of the current look.

elevation.note: No box-shadow anywhere. Depth is expressed only through the --border hairline and the fixed dot-grid backdrop.

scrollDriven.sectionRise: main > section, view() timeline, entry 0% to entry 60%, opacity 0.2 to 1 plus translateY(12px) to 0

motion.reducedMotion: Honored. prefers-reduced-motion disables the cursor blink, the backdrop, the section rise and link transitions.
motion.warning: The sectionRise entry state at opacity 0.2 is what produces the current accessibility score of 95. See docs/baseline/RECON.md.
